channel.title: City Record Digest — Agency Rules
channel.description: NYC City Record Agency Rules notices

item.title: DSNY Final Rule Relating to the Violation Amount for the Failure to Maintain Vacant Lots
item.description:
Sanitation | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Sanitation has adopted a final rule setting the fine amount for violations of the requirement to maintain vacant lots, published Nov. 20, 2026.

item.title: DSNY Proposed Amendment of Rules Relating to Recycling by City Agencies and Institutions
item.description:
Sanitation | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-12-21
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Sanitation will hold a public hearing on Dec. 21, 2026, on its proposed amendment of rules relating to recycling by city agencies and institutions.

item.title: FINAL RULE - AMENDMENTS TO RULES RELATING TO THE ENERGY CONSERVATION CODE
item.description:
Buildings | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Buildings has adopted final amendments to its rules on the Energy Conservation Code, as published Nov. 10, 2026.

item.title: Notice of Adoption-FHV and Taxi Parking at Commercial Meters and Commercial Vehicle Markings
item.description:
Transportation | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Transportation has adopted a rule, published Nov. 6, 2026, governing how for-hire vehicles and taxis may park at commercial meters and how commercial vehicles are marked.

item.title: Final Rule - Amendment of Rules relating to Certain Qualified Inspectors
item.description:
Buildings | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Buildings published a final rule amending its rules on certain qualified inspectors, as listed in The City Record on Oct. 30, 2026.

item.title: City Environmental Quality Review Fee Update Rulemaking
item.description:
City Planning Commission | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-12-02
In plain English (machine-written): The City Planning Commission will hold a public hearing on Dec. 2, 2026, on proposed rules updating the City Environmental Quality Review fees.

item.title: DCWP Automated Customer Service Comment Extension
item.description:
Consumer and Worker Protection | Agency Rules | Notice | Hearing: 2026-12-18
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection has extended the public comment period on its proposed rule about automated customer service, with comments now due by Dec. 18, 2026.

item.title: Notice of Adoption, a rule to amend the Fair Fares program
item.description: Human Resources Administration | Agency Rules | Notice

item.title: Medallion Relief Program Rules
item.description:
Taxi and Limousine Commission | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Taxi and Limousine Commission published a notice on Oct. 29, 2026, about rules for its Medallion Relief Program.

item.title: CECM-SAPO PROPOSED EXTENSION OF STREET FAIR MORATORIUM
item.description:
Office of the Mayor | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-24
In plain English (machine-written): The Office of the Mayor will hold a public hearing on Nov. 24, 2026, on a proposed extension of the street fair moratorium.

item.title: Amendment of Rules regarding Fees for Electrical Permits and Licensing and Compensation of Registered Design Professionals
item.description:
Buildings | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Buildings published a notice on Oct. 22, 2026, proposing amendments to its rules on fees for electrical permits and on licensing and compensation of registered design professionals.

item.title: DCWP NOA Amendment of Debt Collectors Effective Date
item.description:
Consumer and Worker Protection | Agency Rules | Public Hearings
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection has proposed a rule amending the effective date for debt collector regulations, according to a notice published Oct. 21, 2026.

item.title: DCWP NOH Rules Relating to Automated Customer Service Systems
item.description:
Consumer and Worker Protection | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-19
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection will hold a public hearing on Nov. 19, 2026, on proposed rules relating to automated customer service systems.

item.title: DSNY Proposed Rule Expanding Containerization Program
item.description:
Sanitation | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-20
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Sanitation will hold a public hearing on Nov. 20, 2026, on a proposed rule that would expand its containerization program.

item.title: Proposed Rule - Amendment of Rules relating to Natural Gas Alarms
item.description:
Buildings | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-16
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Buildings will hold a public hearing on Nov. 16, 2026, on a proposed rule amending its rules on natural gas alarms.

item.title: Notice of Adoption of Expedited Land Use Review Procedure and Affordable Housing Appeals Board Rules
item.description:
City Planning Commission | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The City Planning Commission has adopted rules setting an expedited land use review procedure and rules for an Affordable Housing Appeals Board, according to a notice published Oct. 15, 2026.

item.title: Department of City Planning Proposed Street Number Rulemaking
item.description:
City Planning | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-17
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning will hold a public hearing on Nov. 17, 2026, on its proposed rule for street numbering.

item.title: Notice of Adoption DSNY Amendment of Penalty for Improper Disposal of Regulated Household Waste
item.description:
Sanitation | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Sanitation adopted a rule amending the penalty for improperly disposing of regulated household waste, according to a notice published Oct. 9, 2026.

item.title: Notice of Public Hearing and Opportunity to Comment on Proposed Rules relating to amendments for the Dining Out NYC program
item.description:
Transportation | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-09
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Transportation will hold a public hearing on Nov. 9, 2026, on proposed rules that would amend the Dining Out NYC program, and the public may comment on them.
